title: The Agriculture Building
about: An ordinary fairground building made unforgettable by the quiet garden and relationship memories hidden behind it.
description: This track reflects on how an otherwise ordinary fairground building became permanently tied to one of the most meaningful places from that summer. Behind the Agriculture Building was a small garden and bench where the noise of the fair seemed to disappear and two young people could simply be together. It's about how places become important not because of what they are, but because of the people and moments we attach to them.
lyrics: Most folks walked right past it,
Just another stop along the way.
Far away from all the noise.
A little bench, a little garden,
A place for two young hearts.
No crowd would ever cheer there,
Just one quiet corner of the fair...
Like the fair had drifted on.
For a little while the whole world
Tomorrow it may be another one.
The bench may still be waiting,
Though the years continue to go.
I'll always think of that little garden,
And the afternoon I spent with you.
